scope: Completed cold host DEV comparison of whole-chunk presence plus a shorter encoder-context rule; rejected, not a product or phone-performance result.

comparators.production: Historical completed cold full-context ASR on identical framing and references.
comparators.presence: Historical cold whole-chunk presence/full-context ASR. Its original run failed at report assembly; independently reviewed deterministic report recovery supplies this comparator.
comparators.candidate: Fresh cold ASR processes using the same cached whole-chunk presence decisions and original PCM, with only encoder context shortened.

conditioning.partial_tail: Use actual remaining samples for RMS and release; no added samples
conditioning.pcm: Signed little-endian PCM16; float64 numpy.rint ties-to-even; reject clipping
conditioning.state: Reset once per source stream; no lookahead beyond the current 512-sample frame

policy.presence: ASR iff native VAD ranges are nonempty; never crop, split, extend, amplify or pad the ASR input.
policy.state: Reset VAD recurrent state and causal conditioner once per original production chunk or direct control WAV.

asr.effective_audio_context: Derived per original WAV frame count by the frozen formula.

policy.skip: Do not invoke ASR, store profile=null and no native ASR JSON. Feed empty decoded list through actual frozen Kotlin reconcile to preserve the ordinary uncertain review cue.
policy.errors: Malformed, truncated, mismatched or failed VAD rejects the run; it must never be treated as absence.

noise.scope: Reused verified VAD decisions; no new noise ASR or VAD inference. This checks skip/cue preservation, not a new native noise-decoding result.

speech_drop_review.limits: These five omissions are inherited from the presence comparator. They are not new empty chunks caused by shortening encoder context. New candidate speech-loss adjudication remains unperformed; numerical/control failures already reject the candidate.

limitations: The same 42 DEV clips recur across gains; normal and quiet variants are correlated, not independent added speech.
Synthetic TTS controls are canaries, not human-speech acceptance.
Cold ASR diagnostics and cached VAD cannot establish persistent-context behavior or speed rankings.
No controlled latency, memory, power, thermal, background-reliability or phone-performance result is claimed.
The candidate is rejected and cannot open held-out; no threshold or formula tuning is performed on this result.
Raw native outputs, references, hypotheses, prompts, paths and logs remain private.
